method: Visual readings on the 6x native coordinate panels, rounded to whole pixels. Skull excludes crest and strap; torso is exposed neck-to-waist. Placement uncertainty about one native pixel. Hidden/foreshortened anatomy is null, not an invented measurement. Forehead boxes and exact uniform reductions are in family-generation.json. 2026-11-10 flagged-family readings supersede the initial annotations; earlier values are retained only as explicitly unreliable history. Area ratios are an independent whole-pose sanity check, not anatomical scale inputs.
